target.description: Research, compare and evaluate the next-generation Project Cockpit through browser-rendered experiments, preserve full decision history and exact implementation provenance, perform source-faithful holistic reintegration under deterministic gates, and evaluate unresolved whole-product interaction/presentation on the complete integrated Cockpit.

known_exposures: Specification 008 and Foundation 021 establish the promoted Cockpit architecture and professional product direction.
Accepted Phase-C mechanisms are bound to exact implementation provenance through the 23-entry manifest and remain protected by deterministic browser gates.
Quiet Graphite, Boxes/Text, A6 and Conversation coexistence remain the held Conversation direction.
The first holistic integration was rejected; Research 088 identified manual reimplementation from summaries as the fidelity failure mode.
Checkpoint 251 established source-faithful holistic reintegration as the protected whole-product substrate.
Research 092 and Research 093 preserve earlier direct-manipulation and architectural 3D rail candidates as historical evidence.
Research 094 tested a permanent resting angled rail after the project owner separated spatial identity from optional clarity expansion.
The project owner then explicitly rejected the current 3D rail treatment and requested the same compact rail as normal 2D.
The project owner requested more vertical separation between Conversation WorkUnit boxes, comparable to the project-general separation.
The project owner identified the Deep Dive project-position compass as visually incorrect and apparently non-functional.
Research 095 found that M17 freezes a compact topology compass but the historical fixture used five static hard-coded dots while the integrated project contains six WorkUnits.
Checkpoint 255 implementation replaces the static compass with a live Project-Grid-derived mini-topology, retaining orientation-only ownership and no selection mutation.
Checkpoint 255 flattens the current right rail, retains clarity-only expansion, and gives Boxes mode a 10px review gap.
Workflow run 33207377429 passed the complete 65-test source-faithful Cockpit suite at implementation target 10cf3cfd26553d95c3b786df6d3a14137a29767a.
independence.notes: No Claude obligation is pending. The current gate is human review of three narrow Checkpoint 255 corrections: Conversation Boxes spacing, the normal flat 2D right-side project rail, and the live Deep Dive topology compass. The previous 3D/angled rail direction is inactive. The live compass reads actual Project Grid topology and selected WorkUnit state but does not own or mutate selection. The complete browser gate passed 65/65 at implementation target 10cf3cfd26553d95c3b786df6d3a14137a29767a. Production /cockpit remains untouched.

last_transition.reason: Human review rejected the current 3D rail treatment, requested more Conversation box spacing and identified the topology compass as visually incorrect and static. Checkpoint 255 implements a flat rail, deliberate Boxes spacing and a live Project-Grid-derived compass under a 65/65 deterministic gate.
